status: Owner requests captured; bounded encounter and streaming implementation policies are proposals awaiting adoption and evidence

additions.requirement: Evaluate seamless block/grid streaming for a continuous world connected by meaningful wilderness exploration, encounters and ship/airship/sandship travel. Preserve deterministic identity, mutations, vehicles, cargo, people, relationships and quests across loading boundaries.
additions.status: Owner-requested design consideration; exact streaming profile not selected

additions.requirement: Prefer combat/encounter timing approaches demonstrated in enjoyable existing games, remain as close to Wait as feasible, and explicitly prevent contradictory cross-boundary interactions and state. Disclose any difference between tactical and world time.
additions.status: Owner decision criterion; final multiplayer timing policy still proposed

traversal_candidate.name: sandship
traversal_candidate.status: New owner-suggested candidate; not claimed to be part of legacy OpenFantasy content
traversal_candidate.needs: Surface, propulsion, route, boarding, cargo and encounter contracts

proposals.proposal: Bounded on-field encounters with full decision holds, strict admission and a shared-pause policy for solo/coordinated sessions
proposals.open: Default multiplayer calendar, environmental dependency scope, entry/exit/merge and inactivity policies

proposals.proposal: Stable grid-addressed world data, predictive loading, separate rendering/simulation residency, durable mutations and coarse persistent society
proposals.open: Chunk sizes, supported speed/visibility, platform budgets and failure behavior

acceptance_tests_to_define: STREAM-01: Cold traversal, abrupt turns and landing at maximum supported speed meet measured visibility/navigation/frame budgets.
STREAM-02: Multi-client boundary crossing and restart preserve terrain, actor identity, relationships, quest bindings and cargo.
TIME-01: Outsiders, hazards and adjacent encounters obey the same declared admission/clock rules; no free attacks, duplicate effects or retroactive changes.
TIME-02: Explicit calendar/maintenance/deadline policy remains understandable during long decision holds and safe exit.
preservation: Older GDD and requirements editions remain unchanged in their existing locations and indexed archives.
